Each tea and cake is decorated with thyme garnish, and I personally like thyme decoration so much that I like it visually.
A variety of baked snacks are also sold.

*Saint-Honore
Saint-Honoré is a traditional French dessert, meaning the queen's dessert, and appears to be shaped like a crown.
A dessert made with cream and choux piled on thin pastry. It is best if the cream has a moderate sweetness level. A characteristic feature is that the shoe is sugar-coated, and the sugar coating is quite thick, giving it a tanghulu-like texture. Because of this sugar coating, it feels like you are eating something other than ‘sugar’. The custard inside the choux is also well made. It is unfortunate that the sugar coating is so strong that the well-made custard is hard to see, but the texture is amazing. The traditional Saint Honoré is said to be a form of vanilla choux piled on top of a white blondie with a chewy texture, but it seems to have undergone many modifications. Conventional Saint Honoré has a chewy and soft texture and seems to have a subtle sweet taste of cream, but this one has a crunchy texture and a bright sugar coating, making the texture and sweetness intense.
Regardless of whether you like or dislike the taste, I like the shiny appearance thanks to the sugar coating.

1. Atmosphere & Interior

The sensibility is definitely different from the moment you enter.
After passing through a hallway designed to resemble rough rocks, a space like a bistro in a cave opens. The lighting tone is soft and not too bright, making it perfect for drinking wine.
• Entrance hallway: Subtle floor lighting + rock wall interior completes the feeling
• Inside the hall: a small stage that can accommodate light performances, various lighting, and comfortable table arrangements.
• Bar counter: wine glasses and bottles illuminated in warm tones.
• Overall impression: It’s dark and atmospheric, but not stuffy.

It's not easy to find a feeling like this in Yeouido, but it's pretty good for a date or quiet gathering.

2. Food review

✔️ Burrata & black sesame cheese dish

The burrata itself was fresh and soft, and the combination of sweet fruit and raw ham went well together.
With black sesame sauce on top, the combination of light + savory + salty + sweet was perfect.

✔️ Beef tartare

The meat was fresh, and the combination of cube-shaped cucumbers and herbs gave it a refreshing tartare feel that wasn't boring.
The crispy bread that came with it completed the taste.

✔️ Vongole style pasta / oil pasta

The seasoning of the pasta is not overly strong and goes well with wine.
The noodles were al dente and had a rich cheese flavor.

✔️ Signature pastas

Starting with the Carbonara series, which has a deep flavor of egg yolk and cheese.
Above-average quality overall, including the flavorful pasta based on tomato sauce.
Rather than a dish to eat with concentration: it feels like a flavor-centered pasta that goes well with wine.

3. Wine pairing

The menu structure is optimized for wine, making it a good fit for wine enthusiasts.
• Tartare/burrata dishes are white and sparkling.
• Rich pasta is served with red wine.
• Overall, it was comfortable because the food was seasoned in a style that did not harm the wine.

The wine list doesn't have a crazy amount of variety, but it feels like a lot of care was put into the composition.

4. Service

Overall bright and friendly style.
The space was spacious so it wasn't hectic, and the speed of food coming out was stable.

It's not tasteless. It just tastes similar to other places, but I think I'll buy it here next time I need a gift.

I ate the mochi about an hour after buying it, but it was a little wet, probably because the packaging was made of paper. I think you should either eat it within an hour of buying it or put it in the refrigerator. The packaging is pretty, but it doesn't look good because it's wet.

A pavilion with the letter “ㅁ” on the side of the store? I think it would be nice to have a place to sit and take a break. However, there are no separate tables. Literally just sit down and rest for a while? degree.

The interior is so pretty. Interior and elegant packaging. It seems so luxurious and elegant that more people go for the interior design.

I'm a little doubtful whether I'll go out and buy one of each.
However, I have a 100% intention to repurchase it when there is something I need to pay special attention to as a gift.
If you give this product as a gift, there seems to be no chance of it failing because of the packaging.

reviews.author: Lee Jeong-won
reviews.text:
Han Jeongseon is a restaurant with a Korean-style interior and delicious glutinous rice cakes.
The store is located in the center of the restaurant area on the first basement level of The Hyundai Seoul, and the walls are filled with white porcelain moon jars, so it is easy to find.
The white porcelain moon jar is said to be meant to contain good fortune in its gentle white, generous and unadorned form, so it might be a good idea to take a look while you wait!

Even though I arrived at 2:30 PM on a weekend, right after lunch, there was still a long line.
There are chairs inside the store that can seat about five or six people, but most people are ordering takeout.
We decided to buy it individually rather than in a box so we could simply taste it.

Han Jeong-seon The Hyundai Seoul branch menu

This is Han Jeong-seon’s menu at The Hyundai Seoul branch.
Starting with the limited quantity of giant glutinous rice cake, glutinous rice cake filled with various fruits are the main menu items, so I had a hard time deciding which one to eat.
If you look at the quantity displayed on the shelf, you can see which one is selling best, and if you eat that, you are at least halfway successful.

King glutinous rice cake
Hongsi glutinous rice cake
Fresh strawberry glutinous rice cake
Mugwort fresh strawberry glutinous rice cake
Permanent Snow Glutinous Rice Cake
Angbeoteo glutinous rice cake
Whole tangerine glutinous rice cake
Honey Gold Pineapple Glutinous Rice Cake
Shine Muscat glutinous rice cake
Gold kiwi glutinous rice cake

You can purchase it individually or as a gift set.
However, the composition of the gift set was set and could not be changed.
I think this is probably because only popular products sell out first!
The 6-piece and 9-piece gift sets differ with or without the Permanent Snow, Red Butter, and Honey Gold Pineapple.
Gift sets can be packaged in a gift box, wrapper, or norigae for an additional fee.

6 piece gift set
Giant strawberry, persimmon, fresh strawberry, mugwort strawberry, whole tangerine, shine muscat

9 piece gift set
Giant strawberry, persimmon, fresh strawberry, perennial snow, fresh mugwort strawberry, red butter, whole tangerine, honey gold pineapple, shine muscat

6-piece gift box +3,000
9-piece gift box +4,000
wrapping cloth +3,000
Norigae +3,000

We bought ice cream and mugwort strawberry glutinous rice cakes, and later, after walking around The Hyundai Seoul one more time, we remembered them again and bought giant strawberries.
Permanent Snow glutinous rice cake contains white strawberries, and giant strawberries contain kingsberries.
The chewy texture of the glutinous rice cake and the light taste of the rice cake went so well with the sweet strawberries!
As the name suggests, the highlight of the mugwort strawberry was the mugwort glutinous rice cake. Although it seemed a bit different from the strawberry, the taste of the mugwort rice cake was quite delicious when put together.
Although it is a bit pricey, the combination of fruit and glutinous rice cake dessert is delicious.

Han Jeongseon is a combination of chewy glutinous rice cake and delicious fruit.
I believe the main branch is in Seongsu-dong, but there are branches in Pangyo, The Hyundai Seoul, and Shinsegae Gangnam, so I think it's a must-try dessert in Seoul.
There are also 6-ball and 9-ball sets, so I can recommend them as gifts!
Personally, I plan to visit again, and next time I want to try glutinous rice cakes made with other fruits.

An electric semi-hot roaster called Novo Mark2 from Japan makes people have the illusion of delicious food.
Linea PB machine with e80 grinder, Pesado + Vinpro tamper + Timemore scale
Brewing coffee is good with a Paragon stand, origami dripper + follow pot + 807 lap sweet + ek43 grinder.
I don't know if ice brewing uses a chilling ball, but it is disappointing that it is brewed in a paper cup without a glass server.

The latte consists of Maeil Milk and blended coffee beans, but it is not a blend of the 4 types of origin listed in the grinder version.
The temperature of the latte is high, but the steam milk workmanship is top-notch in the country.
The foam is so thick and dense that you can almost chew it.
The espresso is monotonous, but the flavor of daily milk is good even in amounts that seem to exceed 380ml.
Simple notes of light smokiness and shelled nuts without acidity.

It is popular due to the synergy of milk and espresso sweetness without bitterness.
Don't expect specialty flavors of flowers and fruits.
(In fact, the latte from nearby Taylor Coffee has the best flavor)

COEX’s ‘Arabica Coffee’ also uses Maeil Milk (Barista Milk) in an electric full-heat roaster called ‘Tornado King’ for comparison.
Regardless of the price, this is better than Arabica coffee with a cleaner cup and bright caramelization of milk foam.
The eco-leather tray is nice to the touch, but not so good in terms of durability, hygiene, and maintenance.

A 6,000 won latte would be nice if it had at least one flower or fruit, but it would be monotonous with only nuts.

Conclusion: Latte is from Taylor Coffee (select Purple Rain Blend).

Camel Coffee is The Hyundai Seoul’s representative blended coffee restaurant.
The location is in the middle of the restaurant area on the basement level. There is no big sign, but there is a long wait and you can look for the pillar with the word camel written on it.
Fortunately, there was little waiting, perhaps because I visited at 4 PM, which was not during lunch or dinner time.

When the staff calls you at the counter, you can go inside the store and place your order.
This is the Camel Coffee The Hyundai Seoul menu.
There are a variety of coffees that can be flavored by blending, including basic Camel coffee, Yeouido coffee, Americano, and latte.
Drinks include misutgaru, cinnamon apple tea, and orange juice, and there are also desserts such as bean butter and queen aman.
I urgently needed a coffee transfusion, so I ordered a cup of cool Camel coffee to take out.
Since the size is not set, you only need to decide on the type of coffee and drink.

Upon ordering, fill out the paper order form, tear off the left end, receive it, and move to the pick-up line.
They say they brew the shots slowly because the coffee machine can overheat, but it felt like the wait time for pickup took longer than the order time.
The interior of the store is open and there are very few seats.
So I think takeout is better than drinking at the store.

After waiting for about 5-6 minutes, a staff member personally checks your number in the pick-up line and hands you a coffee.
It was a small amount, similar to short, rather than the tall amount you usually get at Starbucks, but it had a great scent.
Camel Coffee is a signature coffee topped with soft cream on a flat white latte base.
The flavor of the fragrant coffee beans is felt most deeply, and the caramel flavor and cream taste combine so well~
If I were to compare it, it would be like an Einspänner, but it tasted like a clean latte, so I couldn't help but nod my head.

Camel Coffee, The Hyundai Seoul Branch, where you can enjoy the rich taste of coffee beans, nutty flavor, and clean coffee.
Although the store is small, the flavor of the coffee beans themselves is very deep, so if you want to enjoy delicious coffee, we recommend Camel Coffee!
If you think about coffee when you visit The Hyundai Seoul, you will 200% visit again.

The average price per person is 10,000~20,000 won, which is in the mid-priced range among cafes in Seoul. The overall atmosphere is quiet and pleasant, with appropriate music and lighting, making it a great place to spend a peaceful afternoon. It would have been perfect if it had been a little cheaper, but the relaxed atmosphere and great experience make it worth an occasional visit. Recommended for those looking for a quiet space.

reviews.author: Namaste
reviews.text:
✨ **M29** is a wonderful lounge located on the top floor of the Fairmont Hotel. It is the best place to enjoy the wonderful night view of the city, especially in the evening, when the shining high-rise buildings add to the splendor of the city. 🏙️ As you can see in the photo below, the night view outside the window is truly impressive and catches the eye like a scene from a movie. 🎥🌃

The **fried chicken** 🍗 eaten here is crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, and served with french fries 🍟 for a very satisfying taste. Especially the thinly sliced ​​garlic chips 🧄 added to the flavor. It was a perfect dish to eat with the sauce. 😋

The wine we paired was 🍷 **2021 Shaw + Smith Shiraz**, and the deep, rich taste of the wine went perfectly with the food. The moment of looking at the night view while holding a glass of wine was healing in itself. 🥂✨

The interior of the lounge was also unique and luxurious. 🎨 The lights coming down from the ceiling and the table arrangement were very sophisticated, and the atmosphere was cozy yet luxurious, making it perfect for a special day. 🕯️ The staff were friendly and attentive, so I was able to have a pleasant time. 😊

**M29** is definitely worth a visit if you want a unique experience in the city. 🌟

reviews.author: Nororo
reviews.text:
The view is great. The lighting at The Hyundai Seoul right below is fantastic! When the weather is nice, the roof is open so the atmosphere is even better. There are signature cocktails here, and a new cocktail menu comes out every season, so you can enjoy something new every time you go!
There’s a cool bar in Yeouido, so I think I’ll be going there often!!

reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text:
I stopped by for a meal and a quick cocktail. Since it is a lounge located on the 29th floor of the Fairmont Hotel, the terrace had an impressive view of the high-rise buildings of Yeouido, and there was also a bar where you could sit in front of the bartender.
There were five signature cocktails with themes of water, flowers, sun, earth, and air, as well as non-alcoholic cocktails. I ordered whiskey, and although it was available on the menu, such as Glenfiddich and Balvenie, it wasn't available in reality, so I ended up ordering Abelauer. When ordering alcohol, it came with almonds coated in sweet and spicy seasoning, and the 20,000 won French fries came with two sauces: truffle and red pepper-based mayonnaise.
The interior or cocktails aren't anything special, but it's a great place to have a refreshing drink while looking at the high-rise view.
